author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0019678 propionate metabolic process, methylmalonyl pathway (replaced by) GO:1902859 propionyl-CoA catabolic process
GO:0019629 propionate catabolic process, 2-methylcitrate cycle (replaced by) GO:0019543 propionate catabolic process
GO:0019679 propionate metabolic process, methylcitrate cycle (replaced by) GO:0019543 propionate catabolic process
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31668

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14BQPIqhbWkBKONI5Zn06RsthwZk_nMZ6Xt6ALUphs1g/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
AspGD	8
EcoCyc	2
MTBBASE	5
SGD	2
UniProt	29
EcoliWiki	2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
GO:0019629	hamap2go	HAMAP:MF_01939 > GO:propionate catabolic process, 2-methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019629
GO:0019629	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR012694 Propionate--CoA ligase > GO:propionate catabolic process, 2-methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019629
GO:0019629	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR012695 2-methylisocitrate lyase > GO:propionate catabolic process, 2-methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019629

GO:0019629	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR012709 2-methyl-aconitate isomerase PrpF > GO:propionate catabolic process, 2-methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019629
GO:0019629	unirule2go	UniRule:UR000161617 > GO:propionate catabolic process, 2-methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019629
GO:0019679	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR012705 2-methylcitrate dehydratase PrpD > GO:propionate metabolic process, methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019679
GO:0019679	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR012708 2-methylisocitrate dehydratase AcnD, Fe/S-dependent > GO:propionate metabolic process, methylcitrate cycle ; GO:0019679


Thanks.
